name: Synth Infiltrator
oracle_text:
Improvise (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's a Synth artifact creature in addition to its other types.
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's a Synth artifact creature in addition to its other types.

needs.what: an `add_subtypes` key in a `self_enters_as_copy` replacement's `except_`, written into the copiable values as the permanent enters (707.9b) so the copy is a Synth in addition to the copied creature's subtypes, beside the existing `add_types: ["Artifact"]`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `self_enters_as_copy`'s `except_` accepts only ENTERS_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (add_keywords, add_types, remove_supertypes, name, enters_with); `zones._enter_battlefield` sets copying_add_types but has no subtype field. `characteristics` already reads `add_subtypes` from `copy_overrides`, but only token copies (`copy_permanent`) set that. A self_enters trigger with `add_subtype` would be a separate, later effect rather than a copiable value, and a copy of this permanent would not be a Synth
